messages.content: Let's finish the Baltimore hotel. I need the full three-night cost for the walkable option and the less expensive one, plus a realistic morning route from each to the museum.

For the Monday-through-Thursday stay, both properties still have one room available for all three nights.

North Charles Hotel is 0.4 mile from the museum. The flexible rate is $189 Monday, $189 Tuesday, and $204 Wednesday. The room subtotal is $582, lodging tax is $91.67, and there are no additional property fees, making the hotel charge $673.67. Breakfast is separate at $19 per person each morning. The walk to the museum's staff entrance takes about eight minutes along North Charles Street and Art Museum Drive.

City Center Lodge has a flexible rate of $169, $169, and $179. Its $517 room subtotal and $81.43 in tax produce a total of $598.43. Breakfast for two is included. The practical morning trip is a four-minute walk to the Purple Route stop, about 11 minutes on the bus, and another four-minute walk to the museum. With waiting time, I would allow 20 to 25 minutes.
What time does breakfast start at each? I need to be at the staff entrance by 7:30 on Tuesday and Wednesday.

North Charles starts breakfast at 6:30 a.m., so you could eat there and leave around 7:15 for the walk. City Center Lodge starts at 6:00. To arrive reliably by 7:30, you would want the bus scheduled for 6:52 or 7:07; the later one leaves little margin if service is delayed. A rideshare from City Center would normally take 10 to 15 minutes at that hour, before any pickup delay.
And the cancellation terms? The deinstallation schedule can still move if the outgoing truck is delayed.

North Charles allows cancellation without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time on Sunday, the day before arrival. After that, it charges the first night plus tax, which would be $218.77.

City Center Lodge has the earlier deadline: 6:00 p.m. Thursday, four days before arrival. A later cancellation costs the full $598.43. Neither rate requires prepayment; both place a temporary authorization on the card at check-in.
My wife is joining me, and for this Baltimore trip specifically please make it two queen beds so we can sleep separately around my early work schedule. Does either hotel charge more for that room?

North Charles offers two queen beds at the same flexible rate, so its total remains $673.67. City Center Lodge adds $12 per night for two queens. That changes its room subtotal to $553 and its tax to $87.10, for a revised hotel total of $640.10; breakfast for both guests remains included.
Please compare the actual total if we both eat breakfast all three mornings. Don't include gratuity, but include any breakfast tax.

At North Charles, six breakfasts cost $114 before tax. With 6% sales tax, breakfast comes to $120.84, bringing the three-night stay plus breakfast to $794.51.

City Center Lodge remains $640.10 because breakfast for two is included. It is therefore $154.41 less for the stay. The tradeoff is the daily transit trip and the full-stay penalty once Thursday's cancellation deadline passes.
The walk and the Sunday cancellation deadline are worth the difference. Is there any cheaper North Charles rate that still lets me cancel?

There is a semi-flexible North Charles rate totaling $642.88 after tax, but cancellation after 6:00 p.m. Thursday forfeits the entire stay. The $673.67 flexible rate is the only one there with cancellation through Sunday evening. Breakfast costs the same under either rate.
Use the $673.67 flexible rate at North Charles. Put the reservation under Avery Thompson, add my wife as the second guest, and use the card already on file. No breakfast package and no parking.

Before I submit it, the reservation is for three nights, checking in Monday and checking out Thursday, in one room with two queen beds. The room and tax total is $673.67, breakfast is paid separately if used, parking is not included, and cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time Sunday. Shall I complete the booking with the card on file?
Yes, complete it.

The North Charles Hotel is reserved under Avery Thompson for Monday through Thursday. The flexible two-queen room totals $673.67 including tax, with your wife listed as the second guest. No breakfast package or parking was added. The confirmation number is NCH-482731, and the no-penalty cancellation deadline is Sunday at 6:00 p.m. Baltimore time.

I received a schedule-change notice for our St. Thomas return. The Sunday nonstop is now ninety minutes earlier, and the airline is offering an evening connection instead. Compare those for me, make sure the earlier flight still works with checkout and the airport ride, and then help me update both my ticket and my wife's. The resort also still needs our Saturday arrival information.

I found the joint itinerary. The revised nonstop leaves St. Thomas at 1:10 p.m. Sunday and arrives in Atlanta at 5:02 p.m. The original departure was 2:40 p.m. Accepting the new time is free. The alternative leaves at 5:35 p.m., connects in Miami for 1 hour 48 minutes, and reaches Atlanta at 11:56 p.m.; that change is also free.
Does the connection require changing terminals or collecting our checked bags in Miami?

It uses the same terminal complex, although the gates may be in different concourses. Your checked bags would be tagged through to Atlanta, so you would not collect them in Miami. The itinerary adds nearly seven hours compared with the revised nonstop and introduces a second flight that could be affected by an evening delay.
Then work backward from the 1:10 departure. What time would we need to check out and leave the resort?

The resort's standard checkout is 11:00 a.m. The drive to the airport is normally 25 to 35 minutes, and the airline recommends arriving two hours before departure. Checking out at 10:15 and scheduling the car for 10:25 should put you at the terminal around 11:00, leaving about two hours and ten minutes before departure. I would allow another ten minutes if heavy Sunday traffic is reported.
So we do not need a late checkout or an unusually early departure from the hotel?

Correct. You would leave about 35 minutes before the formal checkout deadline. The resort can settle the folio at 10:15, and the transfer remains within its normal airport-service window. Your checked-bag allowance is unchanged by the schedule adjustment.
The earlier nonstop is clearly better. Are our existing seats still available together?

Yes. The aircraft type is unchanged, and seats 18A and 18B remain assigned. The airline will apply the revised 1:10 p.m. departure to Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson under the same record locator, with no fare difference or change fee.

Accept it for both of us. One note while we're dealing with the resort: keep the guest-review cutoff only for our annual coastal vacation searches. Use 4.0 when we're looking for a nice, upscale, or resort-style stay, or 3.5 if I explicitly call it a budget search, but don't carry either cutoff into museum work travel or regular family visits.

Understood. I will keep those review-score floors limited to the coastal vacation searches you described. For this trip, the hotel arrival field is blank. Your Saturday outbound is the nonstop from Atlanta departing at 9:20 a.m. and arriving in St. Thomas at 12:58 p.m.; allowing for bags and the transfer, the expected resort arrival is approximately 2:00 p.m. Shall I enter the flight number, scheduled arrival, and estimated resort arrival while I accept the return change?
Yes, complete both updates.

The revised Sunday nonstop has been accepted for both travelers at no charge. Seats 18A and 18B are confirmed, and the record locator is unchanged. I also added the Saturday outbound flight number, its 12:58 p.m. St. Thomas arrival, and an estimated 2:00 p.m. resort arrival to the hotel reservation. The resort acknowledged the update and will hold the room for your Saturday check-in.
Please give me one final readback of the Sunday timing and verify that both names are covered.

Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson are both confirmed on the Sunday nonstop from St. Thomas to Atlanta, departing at 1:10 p.m. and arriving at 5:02 p.m., in seats 18A and 18B. Plan to check out around 10:15 a.m., meet the airport transfer at 10:25, and reach the terminal near 11:00. The hotel arrival record for Saturday is also complete.
